description: A waveshaper that applies a tunable sigmoid transfer function to its input

params.text: Sets the curvature of the transfer function; the centre position is a straight line, and the extremes are so steep the curve is nearly square
Chooses the shape of the transfer function: a J curve that steepens at one end, or an S curve that steepens through the middle
Attenuates and inverts the CV that modulates the curvature, -100% to 100%, with no effect at the centre position
Chooses the signal range the shaper works over: 0-10V at UNI, or -5 to 5V at BI. The input is clamped to that range before it is shaped

inputs.text: Modulates the curvature; every 1V here turns the CURVE knob a tenth of its travel clockwise, after the attenuverter
The signal to be shaped, clamped to the chosen range first

outputs.text: The shaped signal, within the chosen range

notes: no anti-aliasing is applied, so shaping an audio signal hard will alias
the module is mono: it reads the first channel of a polyphonic cable and ignores the rest, and every output carries a single channel
